label: Adjustments by Type
description: Frozen adjustments created in a date window by adjustment type: count, net amount, largest and smallest, with the ten largest adjustments (account and customer) under each type.
subreport: reports/subreports/adjustments_by_type_top.jrxml  (a local jrxml resource of the unit named adjustments_by_type_top; the main says repo:adjustments_by_type_top)

inputControls.label: Adjustment type (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(adj_type_cd) AS CODE, TRIM(adj_type_cd) || ' - ' || descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_ADJ_TYPE_L l WHERE l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_ADJ a WHERE a.adj_type_cd = l.adj_type_cd) ORDER BY 1
